name: Weymouth Township (United States)
description: The Taunton Flag of 1774: a British red ensign with the Union Flag in the canton and the words LIBERTY AND UNION in white across the lower part.
history: Weymouth Township is a township in Atlantic County, New Jersey. According to the township's historic fact sheet quoted on Flags of the World, it uses the Taunton Liberty and Union flag because its historical period is correct, it keeps alive an ancestor of the Stars and Stripes, and it is always in production and therefore cheap.
